This has no $\alpha$-H, so with excess HCHO it undergoes crossed Cannizzaro reduction to $\mathrm{CH_3C(CH_2OH)_3}$, formaldehyde being oxidised to formate.

steps.text: (i) Ring bromination adds one Br. (ii) $\mathrm{NO_2\to NH_2}$. (iii) $\mathrm{NH_2\to N_2^+Cl^-}$. (iv) $\mathrm{H_3PO_2}$ replaces the diazonium group with H.
The net result is the removal of the nitro group and the addition of Br: a bromotoluene $\mathrm{C_7H_7Br}$ (the Br position does not change the mass).
